basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-II post under a project-based engagement that is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Candidates applying for this position must possess a B.E./B.Tech in Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental Engineering with 2 years experience or an M.E./M.Tech/Integrated Masters in Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental Engineering. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 35,000 + HRA or Rs. 28,000 + HRA. Eligible applicants can submit their online applications on or before 20 October 2

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified separately on the website

how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria and ensure that essential qualifications and results are fully declared with at least a provisional certificate.
Submit the online application form through the official website before the final deadline of 20-10-2026.
Ensure all required academic and experience details are correctly provided during online submission since no application fees are required.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II at a Glance

rows.details: To develop a CO2-bio refinery by carbon capture from flue gas through medium large scale microbial biomass production as feedstock for biofuels and value added products - (GAP-3103)
Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project
01 (Anticipated vacancy may be 02 nos. depending upon funds and waiting list)
Rs. 35,000/- + HRA (for NET/GATE or equivalent qualified) or Rs. 28,000/- + HRA (for others)
35 years (reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications)
Nil (Candidates are not required to pay any application fees)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications specified for the position. The requirements are structured as follows: Essential Qualification (i): B.E./B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, or Environmental Engineering or Technology from a recognized University, plus 2 years of experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. Essential Qualification (OR - ii): M.E./M.Tech / Integrated Masters in Chemical, Mechanical, or Environmental Engineering or Technology from a recognized University. Job Requirements / Desirable Knowledge: Knowledge of process design and reactor design; knowledge of Algal-based CO2 sequestration; technical report and scientific article writing; knowledge of process simulation software like Aspen and DWSIM.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments are categorized into two slabs based on candidate qualifications: Category (a): Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant Professorship or GATE, or National level examinations conducted by Central Government departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. Category (b): Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA for other candidates who do not qualify under category (a). The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Tenure will not exceed six or seven years as per CSIR guidelines. HRA is admissible as per applicable rules, and project staff must arrange their own accommodation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria and ensure that essential qualifications and results are fully declared with at least a provisional certificate. Submit the online application form through the official website before the final deadline of 20-10-2026. Ensure all required academic and experience details are correctly provided during online submission since no application fees are required.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through an online interview via MS Teams, Skype, or other online platforms. The date of the interview will be notified separately on the official website. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the online interview based on criteria adopted by the Screening Committee if a large number of applications are received.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and engagement will not confer any right for regularization against any CSIR or CSIR-NEERI posts.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance (HRA) is admissible as per applicable rules on top of the monthly emoluments of Rs. 35,000/- or Rs. 28,000/-.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the higher monthly emolument of Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA?
faq.answer: Candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC, ICAR, or ICMR NET lectureship, Assistant Professorship, GATE, or National-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST are eligible for the higher emolument.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. How will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted online through platforms such as MS Teams or Skype, and the specific date will be notified on the official NEERI website.
